gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-archivo: Small letters that stand almost as tall as capitals mark Noto Serif Todhri, with a restrained thick and thin look throughout. And Archivo supplies an editorial, outward-opening sans that sits comfortably beneath its modest contrast.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-fs-asap: Noto Serif Todhri is traditional and refined, its mild contrast never turning stark, with small letters nearly as tall as capitals. Asap keeps its open arcs and tall body height steady, so a long stretch of text reads smoothly.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-fs-epilogue: Epilogue is curvy and loose, with a tall-bodied lowercase and wiry, pressure-free lines. Noto Serif Todhri brings the pair's strongest quality: a refined, traditional heading whose small letters nearly match its capitals.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-fs-fira-sans: Noto Serif Todhri's small letters rise almost to capital height, and its thin strokes carry about half the weight of its thick ones. Fira Sans stays smooth and generous below.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-fs-public-sans: Noto Serif Todhri sets a traditional tone with tightening at its curve tops. Public Sans does the opposite job, offering a hefty, sturdy lowercase with broad counters that hold up text.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-fs-supreme: Tiny lowercase letters that nearly reach capital height give Noto Serif Todhri its character, with heavy stems easing into lighter curves. Supreme adds a dense, crisp band of text, its letters held open rather than curled shut.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with a tall x-height and smooth curves drawn at steady pressure. Beside Noto Serif Todhri's subtle, etched-glass weight changes, the text feels crisp and unhurried.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-manrope: Manrope keeps a bright gap at each curved letter's mouth and holds its line to one width. And Noto Serif Todhri, with bowls that thin slightly at the sides, gives that plainness a traditional counterpoint.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-montserrat: Wide, gliding, wire-fine lines meet worn-stamp texture here. Noto Serif Todhri excels at restrained thick-thin play in its headings, and Montserrat handles the body with oversized e and a counters and no shading at all.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-satoshi: Noto Serif Todhri sits between monoline and razor-thin hairlines. Satoshi's soaring x-height and wide-open e, with every stroke cut to a single width, make the pair's strongest quality its quiet, wiry contrast.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-switzer: Switzer draws tubular, wire-like letters with a tall waist line and c tips that never creep toward touching. Beside Noto Serif Todhri's worn-stamp thick-thin play, the contrast of stroke is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-work-sans: Noto Serif Todhri's curves keep real weight even at their thinnest points, giving its small letters a sturdy refinement. And Work Sans matches that firmness with a high mean line and joins that never taper.
gen-gf-noto-serif-toto-fs-asap: Soft ink-trace strokes give Noto Serif Toto its bookish weight. If that heading shrinks, its gentle thick-thin shading fades, while Asap keeps its open arcs and tall lowercase, so it holds up even when enlarged.
gen-gf-noto-serif-toto-fs-epilogue: Curvy, loose, a bit wiry: that's Epilogue's mood under a bookish heading. And while Noto Serif Toto pulls faintly between heavy verticals and lighter horizontals, the sans below runs one unbroken line, so a long stretch of text glides.
gen-gf-noto-serif-toto-fs-fira-sans: Authoritative is the mood Noto Serif Toto sets, with a restrained swell like a round brush barely pressed. And Fira Sans takes over where its large x-height and wide-open s curves do the steady work, with no swelling at all.
gen-gf-noto-serif-toto-fs-public-sans: Noto Serif Toto draws its bowls full and its thick-thin shift mild. Public Sans follows with a hefty lowercase and broad counters, so enlarging it would only make it feel sturdier, while a small heading stays legible.
gen-gf-noto-serif-toto-fs-supreme: Noto Serif Toto leads with ink-trace strokes and a modest gap between its stems and hairlines, bookish and authoritative. Supreme lays a crisp, heavy-looking band beneath it.
gen-gf-noto-serif-toto-general-sans: Noto Serif Toto carries a soft, hand-inked modulation in its lines, with bowls that fill the line. But General Sans draws a smooth, unshaded stroke at a large x-height, so a heading made small still sits clearly above it.
gen-gf-noto-serif-toto-manrope: Bookish ink, then bright openness. Manrope keeps a gap at every curve's mouth and a pen line of one width, so it can run a touch smaller than you'd expect while Noto Serif Toto handles the authority.
gen-gf-noto-serif-toto-satoshi: Approachable is Satoshi's mood, soaring x-height and all, beneath a heading drawn with a barely tilted calligraphy nib. But Noto Serif Toto brings the bookish gravity, while the thread-thin sans stays smooth and wide-open under it.
gen-gf-noto-serif-toto-switzer: Noto Serif Toto writes with a modest, bookish modulation. Switzer's tubular, wire-like letterforms and tall waist line give the pair its sharpest quality: a sans-serif that never slows the eye with thick-thin contrast.
gen-gf-noto-serif-toto-work-sans: A soft ink-trace stroke, with thin parts only slightly slimmer than the stems, marks Noto Serif Toto as bookish and authoritative. Work Sans keeps a flat line, modern and high-waisted.
